**[01:31:04.960] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001456)

**[01:31:07.540] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001457)

**[01:31:11.520] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001459)

**[01:31:13.940] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001460)  
part of the decision

**[01:31:16.020] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001461)

**[01:31:18.040] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001462)

**[01:31:19.960] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001463)  
In 2022, we were

**[01:31:21.700] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001464)

**[01:31:32.140] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001469)

**[01:31:40.320] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001473)

**[01:31:42.100] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001474)

**[01:31:46.340] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001476)

**[01:31:47.720] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001477)

**[01:31:49.760] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001478)

**[01:42:14.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001749)  
No, they go back to the reserves.

**[01:42:17.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001750)  
Go back to the reserves.

**[01:42:18.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001751)  
Nothing goes to the treasury. They remain with the BSP?

**[01:42:22.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001752)  
They remain with the BSP.

**[01:42:24.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001753)  
So, perhaps we can have a breakdown of what that looks like.

**[01:42:29.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001754)  
Kasi, kung tutuusin, kung benta tayo ng benta ng ginto, sabi po ninyo, 2026, kumita tayo sa 4,308 na presyo, eh, bagsak naman ang bagsak ang ating reserves.

**[01:42:43.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001755)  
So, ang ibig sabihin, yung 103.3 billion at end July to 97.95 end October, kasama na doon yung gold proceeds.

**[01:42:57.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001756)  
Yung proceeds, balik sa reserves.

**[01:42:59.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001757)  
Kasama na doon.

**[01:43:00.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001758)  
Pero in spite of selling gold, bagsak pa rin ang ating reserves na nasa wala pang 98 billion. Tama po ba?

**[01:43:08.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001759)  
Yes.

**[01:43:09.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001760)  
What drove the decline?

**[01:43:11.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001761)  
Does the BSP still expect reserves to reach 104? How? Yung tanong ko kanina.

**[01:43:18.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001762)  
At magbebenta pa ba tayo ng ginto para ma-achieve yung 104 bago matapos ang taon?

**[01:43:27.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001763)  
So, the decline is consistent with what's happening with the exchange rate.

**[01:43:33.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001764)  
We increase our reserves whenever we have more exports than imports.

**[01:43:41.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001765)  
And so, we just, the difference adds to the reserves.

**[01:43:48.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001766)  
So, do we think, what is our projection po sa BSP? Will the continued grim economic outlook drive down further our reserves to dangerous or insecure levels?

**[01:44:03.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001767)  
Sa palagay ninyo?

**[01:44:04.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001768)  
Yung outlook na kailangan natin bantayan, yung outlook for the trade deficit.

**[01:44:09.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001769)  
For the trade deficit.

**[01:44:10.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001770)  
And the outlook for the current account deficit.

**[01:44:14.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001771)  
So, eto nga, maraming natatakot din doon sa sinasabi nga na tuloy-tuloy kayo magtataas pa ng interest rate.

**[01:44:27.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001772)  
This hawkish forward stance na pwedeng umabot sa 2027. Pwede pa ba taasan ng interest rate? Napakataas na po?

**[01:44:39.240] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001773)  
Napakataas na po, pero napakataas din ng inflation eh. So, kung bumaba na ang inflation, hindi na kami magtataas.

**[01:44:47.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001774)  
Pwede pang magbaba. So, the actions that can be taken, kasi yun ang gustong maalaman ng mga senador.

**[01:44:56.240] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001775)  
Unang-una, yung interest rate hikes.

**[01:45:00.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001776)  
Nasabi nga ninyo, hindi naman pwedeng pataas ng pataas kasi talagang wala nang gagalaw.

**[01:45:06.160] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001777)  
Takot na takot na nga yung mga negosyante, hindi na makahiram.

**[01:45:10.200] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001778)  
Ikalawa, yung foreign exchange market intervention.

**[01:45:15.460] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001779)  
Yung sinasabi nyo na ginagastos natin yung gold kasama ng foreign reserves

**[01:45:20.480] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001780)

**[01:45:30.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001781)  
Yung ikatlo, yung forward guidance ninyo na sinasabi ninyo na wala kayong itatanto.

**[01:45:41.380] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001782)  
Talagang you will continue to act on the interest rates.

**[01:45:46.440] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001783)  
Is that something that we have to expect?

**[01:45:51.100] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001784)  
This rather hawkish stance.

**[01:45:53.900] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001785)  
Well appreciated and merited considering the circumstances po.

**[01:45:58.860] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001786)  
Unfortunately.

**[01:46:00.000] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001787)  
We have to contend with high inflation as you've indicated.

**[01:46:05.020] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001788)  
And the most effective tool that any country has to slow inflation down

**[01:46:14.340] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001789)

**[01:46:18.120] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001790)  
From experience over 50 years, there's no other more effective tool than the interest rate.

**[01:46:27.140] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001791)  
But are there any other...

**[01:46:30.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001792)  
Are there any other actions that the BSP can take

**[01:46:34.020] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001793)

**[01:46:40.480] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001794)  
There are less effective actions.

**[01:46:42.980] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001795)  
In the old days, we used to tighten money supply.

**[01:46:46.740] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001796)  
That's right.

**[01:46:47.680] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001797)  
But that turns out to be equivalent to raising interest rates.

**[01:46:52.280] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001798)  
And raising interest rates is more reliable.

**[01:46:55.740] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001799)  
Yes.

**[01:46:56.400] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001800)  
As a way of taming inflation.

**[01:47:00.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001801)  
So, is there anything else we can look forward to po?

**[01:47:04.460] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001802)  
Aside from the fiscal monetary measures of the BSP.

**[01:47:08.320] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001803)  
You mentioned previously that external supply shocks were the primary reason

**[01:47:14.400] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001804)

**[01:47:19.380] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001805)  
And then we are also assuming there will be tremendous El Nino food cost increases.

**[01:47:26.480] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001806)  
So, at this point, we are saying it's $10 billion.

**[01:47:30.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001807)  
Yes, I believe.

**[01:47:31.500] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001808)  
In terms of damages, we are expecting El Nino to continue until next year, 2027.

**[01:47:38.660] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001809)  
Is there light at the end of the tunnel?

**[01:47:42.120] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001810)  
Kasi may El Nino pa eh.

**[01:47:44.820] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001811)  
Natatakot din kami ngayon sa El Nino.

**[01:47:47.720] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001812)  
Yung pong external supply shock.

**[01:47:50.120] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001813)  
Nanginginig na po kami.

**[01:47:51.440] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001814)  
Ang dami-dami natin kinataklutan po.

**[01:47:53.600] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001815)  
Pwede bang explain ko lang yung external supply shock?

**[01:47:58.220] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001816)  
Dalawa yung effect nun eh.

**[01:48:00.000] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001817)  
May effect dun sa presyo ng oil.

**[01:48:03.580] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001818)  
Wala tayong oil eh.

**[01:48:04.680] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001819)  
Nag-i-import tayo ng oil.

**[01:48:06.280] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001820)  
Lahat ng oil natin imported.

**[01:48:09.580] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001821)  
So, malaki tama sa atin.

**[01:48:11.860] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001822)  
At saka yung nangyayari din dun, lumalakas ang dollar.

**[01:48:16.040] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001823)  
Yung tinitingnan kasi natin, exchange rate, peso, dollar.

**[01:48:20.900] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001824)  
Pero yung dollar mismo, pag kinuha mo yung exchange rate against six major currencies,

**[01:48:28.080] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001825)  
lumalakas talaga siya eh.

**[01:48:30.000] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001826)  
So, damay lang tayo dun.

**[01:48:31.480] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001827)  
Hindi peso lang ang humihina.

**[01:48:34.860] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001828)  
Lumalakas ang dollar against major currencies.

**[01:48:37.680] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001829)  
And that's the number one factor that explains the depreciation of the peso.

**[01:48:43.480] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001830)  
It's dollar strength is the number one factor.

**[01:48:47.440] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001831)  
That's three times more important than the increase in oil prices.

**[01:48:51.760] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001832)  
Opo.

**[01:48:53.560] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001833)  
Huli na lang po.

**[01:48:55.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001834)

**[01:48:57.540] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001835)  
Pero nasabi po ninyo,

**[01:49:00.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001836)

**[01:49:02.600] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001837)

**[01:49:05.060] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001838)  
Marami pong nasinda.

**[01:49:06.820] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001839)

**[01:49:10.800] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001840)  
Wala lang pang invest.

**[01:49:12.360] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001841)  
Ubus na-ubus na sa gasolina, sa kuryente,

**[01:49:15.360] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001842)

Hindi naman yung,

**[01:49:24.760] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001846)  
Mag-save ka lang, pumain.

**[01:49:26.040] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001847)

**[01:49:28.540] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001848)  
Mauunang pagkain.

**[01:49:30.000] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001849)

**[01:49:32.140] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001850)  
Na hindi po nag-i-invest.

**[01:49:33.560] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001851)  
Hindi nag-save.

**[01:49:35.700] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001852)  
Hindi nag-save.

**[01:49:36.820] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001853)

**[01:49:37.980] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001854)

**[01:49:40.860] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001855)

**[01:49:43.180] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001856)

**[01:49:47.640] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001858)  
Maraming salamat po sa inyong pagdalo

**[01:49:52.820] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001860)

**[01:49:58.040] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001862)

**[01:50:00.000] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-001863)

**[01:50:09.720] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001867)

**[01:50:12.340] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001868)

**[01:50:14.480] BSP Governor Eli M. Remolona Jr.** (asr-001869)

**[02:43:08.880] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003328-split-3)  
Thank you, Mr. President. Thank you, Majority Floor Leader. To the officials and members of the Civil Service Commission, led by its Chairperson, Attorney Marilyn Baruwayap, and to the Career Executive Service Board,

**[02:43:25.440] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003329)  
led by Chairperson Urduja Alvarado, a pleasant good afternoon to everyone. As the Vice Chairperson of the Subcommittee H of the Committee on Finance, I am pleased to present the proposed budgets of two vital institutions that play an indispensable role in our government's pursuit of an efficient, professional, responsive public service. For Fiscal Year 2027, the proposed total new appropriations of the Civil Service Commission stand at 3.1 billion pesos.

**[02:43:55.440] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003330)  
This is 1 billion lower than its proposed budget under the National Expenditure Program, but higher than the 2.91 billion allocation under the General Appropriations Bill. The additional funding request by the CSC and approved by your subcommittee will be used to augment CSC Central Office MOOE, as well as to provide additional funding for its ICT requirements. Meanwhile, the proposed total new appropriations for the Career or of the Career Executive Service Board for Fiscal Year 2027 amount to 200.8 million pesos,

**[02:44:25.440] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003331)  
which is higher than the amounts provided under both the NEP and the GAB. Your subcommittee likewise approved the CESB's additional budget request of 62 million pesos, which will be used to augment its MOOE and capital outlay requirements. These allocations represent our continuing commitment to strengthening the institutions that develop, nurture,

**[02:44:55.440] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003332)  
and uphold the quality of our public servants.

**[02:45:00.000] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003333)  
Sa madaling sabi, ang pamumuhunan natin sa dalawang institusyon na ito ay pamumuhunan din sa ating mga lingkod bayan.

**[02:45:08.920] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003334)  
At kung mas mahusay ang ating mga lingkod bayan, mas mahusay din po ang serbisyong may ibibigay natin sa ating mga kababayan.

**[02:45:16.240] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003335)  
With these points in mind, I respectfully submit for the body's consideration to propose new appropriations for Fiscal Year 2027 of the Civil Service Commission and the Career Service Executive Board.

**[03:10:00.080] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003931)  
I rise to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget

**[03:10:04.240] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003932)  
of the Presidential Communications Office

**[03:10:06.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003933)  
and its attached agencies and corporations.

**[03:10:10.100] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003934)  
As a journalist myself, I firmly believe

**[03:10:12.540] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003935)  
that effective communication is an essential part of good governance.

**[03:10:16.900] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003936)  
In an era where information spreads rapidly

**[03:10:19.940] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003937)  
and where misinformation, disinformation, and fake news continue to pose serious challenges,

**[03:10:26.960] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003938)  
the PCO plays a vital role.

**[03:10:28.280] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003939)  
In ensuring that our people are timely, accurately, and properly informed of government programs

**[03:10:35.200] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003940)  
and initiatives that directly affect their daily lives.

**[03:10:39.520] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003941)  
For fiscal year 2027, the Senate Committee on Finance recommends a total budget of

**[03:10:44.460] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003942)  
3,423,128,000 in new appropriations for the PCO and its attached agencies and corporation.

**[03:10:55.160] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003943)  
Broken down as follows.

**[03:10:56.960] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003944)  
PCO proper.

**[03:10:58.280] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003945)  
790.51 million.

**[03:11:01.380] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003946)  
Bureau of Communication Services.

**[03:11:03.700] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003947)  
76.88 million.

**[03:11:06.360] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003948)  
National Printing Office.

**[03:11:07.680] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003949)  
21.474 million.

**[03:11:10.200] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003950)  
News and Information Bureau.

**[03:11:12.160] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003951)  
148.438 million.

**[03:11:15.740] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003952)  
Philippine Information Agency.

**[03:11:17.820] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003953)  
683.04 million.

**[03:11:20.700] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003954)  
Presidential Broadcast Service.

**[03:11:22.700] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003955)  
Bureau of Broadcast Services.

**[03:11:24.640] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003956)  
471.950 million.

**[03:11:26.720] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003957)  
And

**[03:11:28.280] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003959)  
Presidential Broadcast Staff.

**[03:11:29.640] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003960)  
Or RTVM.

**[03:11:30.680] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003961)  
233.027 million.

**[03:11:34.400] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003962)  
2,424,821,000 subtotal.

**[03:11:39.840] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003963)  
The proposed budget also includes budgetary support for the following attached corporations.

**[03:11:45.740] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003964)  
People's Television Network.

**[03:11:47.460] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003965)  
738.378 million.

**[03:11:50.960] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003966)  
And Intercontinental Broadcasting Corporation.

**[03:11:53.960] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003967)  
IBC 13.

**[03:11:54.920] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003968)  
At 259.929 million.

**[03:11:58.280] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003969)  
Subtotal 998,307,000.

**[03:12:02.980] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003970)  
The proposed appropriation represents a 26.10% increase from the Fiscal Year 2026 General Appropriations Act.

**[03:12:12.380] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003971)  
This increase is intended to strengthen government communication services and ensure public access to accurate, timely, and reliable information.

**[03:12:21.140] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003972)  
For transparency, House Bill No. 10858 introduced additional appropriations.

**[03:12:27.380] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003973)  
Of approximately 673 million, including an additional 25 million for the PCO proper, 12 million for the Philippine Information Agency, 35.986 million for IBC, and 600 million for the operations of PTV.

**[03:12:46.440] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003974)  
The Senate Committee on Finance retained these allocations and recommended an additional 223.943 million for IBC-13.

**[03:12:58.060] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003977)  
Primarily to support the network's maintenance and operating expenses pending its privatization.

**[03:13:04.220] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-003978)  
With these considerations, Mr. President, I respectfully submit the proposed Fiscal Year 2027 budget of the Presidential Communications Office and its attached agencies and corporations for the consideration and approval of this August Chamber.

**[04:00:39.480] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004436)  
Thank you, Mr. President. Thank you, Mr. Majority Floor Leader.

**[04:00:44.260] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004437)  
As Vice Chair of the Committee on Finance, I'm honored to defend the fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Tourism,

**[04:00:51.160] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004438)  
its attached agencies, namely Intramuros Administration, National Parks Development Committee,

**[04:00:57.720] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004439)  
Philippine Commission

**[04:00:58.560] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004440)

**[04:01:04.540] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004441)  
Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority, and Tourism Promotions Board.

**[04:01:09.620] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004442)

**[04:01:16.700] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004443)

**[04:01:24.580] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004444)

**[04:01:28.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004445)  
reached a staggering 2.27 trillion pesos.

**[04:01:33.240] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004446)  
Our tourist arrivals also continue to grow steadily,

**[04:01:36.280] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004447)  
from 3.31 million in the first semester of fiscal year 2025 to 3.41 million for fiscal year 2026.

**[04:01:44.700] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004448)  
This growth is bolstered by DOT's outstanding global accomplishments,

**[04:01:48.400] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004449)  
which include the successful launch of 20 new international flights as of September 2026,

**[04:01:56.220] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004450)  
bringing in 472,240

**[04:01:58.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004451)  
projected sold seats.

**[04:02:03.080] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004452)  
Furthermore, the Philippines is proudly secured a spot as the number one retirement destination in the world.

**[04:02:09.280] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004453)  
Our unmatched marine biodiversity has also earned us the title of the world's leading dive destination for seven consecutive years,

**[04:02:18.840] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004454)  
propelling us to the top five globally in terms of highest income generated from dive tourism.

**[04:02:25.700] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004455)  
Additionally, our aggressive push for astronomy tourism,

**[04:02:28.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004456)  
has yielded remarkable results,

**[04:02:30.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004457)  
generating a value of 366 million pesos in 2025.

**[04:02:35.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004458)  
Mr. President, despite these monumental achievements and the massive returns the sector brings to our economy,

**[04:02:43.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004459)  
the funding for the department and its attached agencies will have a total available appropriation of only 4.03 billion

**[04:02:51.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004460)  
in the National Expenditure Program of 2027.

**[04:02:54.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004461)  
This is 337.7 million lower,

**[04:02:58.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004462)  
presenting a 7.7% decrease compared to the 4.37 billion budget in 2026.

**[04:03:07.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004463)  
As for the attached corporations,

**[04:03:09.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004464)  
their respective funding levels show varying increases and reductions under the NEP 2027.

**[04:03:16.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004465)  
The duty-free Philippines corporation will have an increase in its total sources of funds from 2.074 billion in 2026 to 2.472 billion

**[04:03:27.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004466)  
in 2027.

**[04:03:28.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004467)  
On the other hand,

**[04:03:30.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004468)  
TIEZA's approved corporate operating budget decreased from 12.7 billion in 2026 to 7.7 billion in 2027.

**[04:03:41.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004469)  
Similarly, the Tourism Promotions Board total funding declined from 1.864 billion in 2026 to 1.119 billion in 2027.

**[04:03:52.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004470)  
The National Parks Development Committee's COB also decreased

**[04:03:57.500] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004471)  
From 81.6 million pesos to 73 million pesos.

**[04:04:03.040] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004472)  
Meanwhile, the Philippine Retirement Authority will rely entirely on its corporate fund for 2027

**[04:04:09.320] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004473)  
with no national government subsidy or trust receipts program.

**[04:27:00.760] Senator Erwin T. Tulfo** (asr-004805)

**[10:30:55.500] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013179)  
The other question is also something that's been mysterious for many of us.

**[10:31:00.400] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013180)  
Why is the trade deficit widening despite record exports?

**[10:31:06.360] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013181)  
In September, goods exported rose by 35.6% and yet the deficit widened by 10%.

**[10:31:16.020] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013182)

**[10:31:29.600] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013183)

**[10:31:40.460] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013184)  
Mr. President, so there was an increase in imports of capital goods.

**[10:31:46.020] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013185)

**[10:31:49.140] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013186)

**[10:31:53.700] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013187)

**[10:31:56.460] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013188)

**[10:32:01.100] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013189)

**[10:32:06.060] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013190)

**[10:32:08.500] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013191)

**[10:32:14.440] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013192)

**[10:32:14.580] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013193)

**[10:32:20.840] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013194)

**[10:32:23.920] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013195)

**[10:32:39.860] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013196)

**[10:32:40.700] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013197)

**[10:32:41.880] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013198)  
Yes.

**[10:32:42.300] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013199)  
Yes.

**[10:32:44.580] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013200)

**[10:32:52.300] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013201)

**[10:33:01.980] Senator Imee R. Marcos** (asr-013203)

**[10:35:58.280] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013253)

So, last year, Mr. Chairman, I had asked the Secretary on the status of the regulations of the e-cigarettes.

**[11:00:19.360] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013694)  
Because the history of this is that, by law, a law that I opposed, the power to regulate the use, the putting on the market of e-cigarettes and vapes was large in DTI.

**[11:00:38.100] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013695)  
I objected to that because DTI, as far as I know, has never had the power and the capacity to look into the health of human beings.

**[11:00:47.440] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013696)  
So, if I recall correctly, and the Secretary can clarify that statement, but if I recall correctly, on the statement, she basically agreed with me that they don't have that capacity.

**[11:00:58.780] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013697)  
And the commitment was that they would be coordinating with DOH, FDA in particular, because FDA is the Food and Drug Authority Administration that has that power.

**[11:01:12.420] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013698)  
There is a requirement for certain types of equipment, and they do not have that equipment.

**[11:01:17.440] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013699)  
For Pangatlo na yata ang Secretary, si Secretary ngayon, na umaamin naman na wala naman silang equipment na gano'n.

**[11:01:26.020] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013700)  
So, this time, I was happy kasi Secretary said they will be coordinating with DOH on the testing of the e-liquids.

**[11:01:32.900] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013701)  
Kasi, like every Secretary before her, ang kaya lang nila i-test is yung gadget.

**[11:01:38.480] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013702)

**[11:01:47.440] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013703)

**[11:02:02.100] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013704)  
So, that's just the update I want, what kind of coordination has happened.

**[11:02:08.940] Senator Pia S. Cayetano** (asr-013705)

**[11:02:45.800] Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV** (asr-013714)
